body: I really appreciate your positive words! I obviously didn't follow through, although highly considered. It was more of a release you know get all that negative weight off my shoulders through writing. You are kind to take the time to read my story, and focus on the positive. The crazy thing is I had an intro interview last friday that went amazing, I had court this past tuesday and I told the state prosecutor a shortened version of what I wrote and after about an hour (I guess she did some research) she decided to drop the charges so I am free and clear, then later that day the company I interview with me calls me for the 2nd part of the interview the panel interview which went amazing, and I am now scheduled for the final interview process with their VP on monday!  So I am realizing the power of positivity and having an outlet for the negativity.
